title: Api proposal: currentRefinementsList widget
body:
The goal is to be able to list the current refinement and delete them one by one or all at one time. Example from Jadopado : ![capture d ecran 2015-09-22 a 11 48 39](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1689007/10015385/205abb20-6120-11e5-8c5c-2923f71f6f3d.png) ``` search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.currentRefinementsList({ container: '#current-refinements', //clearAllButon // true or false //template }) ); ``` Resulting dom would look something like: ```
Clear All
Men x
Nike x
``` What do you think ?

comments.body: :+1: we might iterate on the `currentRefinementsList` naming and use `ul/li` instead of `div`, but we'll need it!
Yep, totally agree this one is missing and needed.

Alright, based on #378 here is the API I'm going for: ``` js search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.currentRefinedValues({ container: '#current-refinements-list', cssClasses: {root, header, body, clearAll, item, link, count, footer}, facets: [ // Optional, if not specified, takes all of the facets { name: 'category'[, transformData: function (data) { /* ... */ return data; }]}, { name: 'brand'[, transformData: function (data) { /* ... */ return data; }]} ], templates: { header: '', item: '' + // Called with this.facets[current_facet.name].transformData({cssClasses, facetName, url, name, count}) '' + ' {{ name }}' + ' ' + ' {{ count }}' + ' ' + '', clearAll: '' + '' + ' Clear all' + '', footer: '' }, clearAll: 'after', // [true, false, 'before', 'after'] (true == 'before') hideContainerWhenNoRefinements: true }) ); ```

Looks good. Just have two questions:
- Why a `label`? Shouldn't an `a` be better?
- What is `cssClasses.clearItem`?

Ah yes indeed @pixelastic, labels should be kept for forms. We have a label in refinementList only because the default template is using a checkbox so it makes sense (click on label = validate checkbox)
Alright for an `a`, and the `cssClasses` were indeed wrong.
@Jerskouille can you create a new issue and go for it so we avoid confusions about this current issue proposal/state? thx
